name: Phantom
additional_info: Also triggers if your critical is dodged. If your critical is blocked, nothing will happen. If your critical is parried, then this Talent will go on cooldown without providing any benefits. When bypassing an opponent's block, your attack phases through their block and hits them directly, applying hitstun and Shaky Block while dealing the full damage. This is not 100% Chip Damage.
desc: After landing your critical, for the next 6 seconds, your next basic attack bypasses block, whilst also granting 0.02 additional swingspeed for the duration. [45 second CD]
